title: Leicester proved money no longer decides the Premier League

defects.quote: Claudio Ranieri's side begun the season as 500-1 outsiders with the bookmakers.
defects.correction: Leicester were widely quoted at 5000-1 to win the 2015-16 Premier League before the season.

defects.quote: Mid-table clubs now win 40% more points against the top six than they did a decade ago.
If one club with a modest budget can win the league, then money clearly does not decide who wins.
defects.known_rebuttal: One outlier does not overturn a strong correlation: across Premier League seasons, wage spending explains most of the variation in final league position. Leicester's title coincided with unusual collapses by Chelsea and others, and in the seasons since, the title has gone almost exclusively to the highest-spending clubs.
